catalogue_name: Ops Sentinel Project 3 - Curated Technical References
notes: Original short investigation summaries and read-only checks, linking to source documentation. We do not copy vendor documentation or claim these records establish a cause or confirmed remedy. Source URLs and topics were checked on the review date; technical relevance still requires engineer judgement.
